Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children and emit actual status at least every 60 seconds. Keep every output gap below 600 seconds, including synthesis. Use unbuffered output. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. Keep every tool call bounded. Stop measurement by 3600 seconds and reserve at least 900 seconds within the 4800-second cap for validation. Never pad duration.

experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind evidence to this task and actual invocation.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Terminal honest_verdict starts complete_; verdict_class is exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished retryable owned work is partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: Each blocked_* or complete_blocked_* verdict names the failed check, upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed; missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Declare actual work; imported model output is cached evidence, never current generation.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Every intended unit and arm has a metric or missing reason; seeds, siblings and repeats do not multiply independent questions.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle positives use circular_positive; exposed experiments and engineering fixtures keep both generalization scores zero.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Qualification is distinct from scientific benefit; failed required checks forbid positive classes.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Preserve actual work and immutable primitive operands.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: Explain each extra metric/gate and list imported fields with original producer hashes.
source_controls_ready_score, feature_manifest_reference, question_roles, predictor_access_log, control_parameter_counts: principle: Test information while preserving historical exposure and split custody.
